title: Nomad wire conformance corpus
description: The shape of conformance/wire-vectors.json. Published so a second implementation can validate the corpus with its own tooling instead of inferring the format from this project's encoder. It constrains the corpus file, not the wire formats the vectors describe; those are in conformance/COMPATIBILITY.md.

version.description: Frozen corpus version. Exactly one value is accepted; an unrecognised version must be refused rather than downgraded to.

corpus_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the ordered set of vectors, so the corpus has one identity independent of file formatting.

message.description: The frozen wire-format label this vector is an instance of. Every value must appear in COMPATIBILITY.md, which a test enforces.

bytes_hex.description: The vector's bytes, lowercase hex, even length.

length.description: Byte count. Must equal half the length of bytes_hex; stated separately so a truncated hex string is a contradiction rather than a shorter vector.

fields.description: Human-readable decode of the vector. Values are strings so the corpus has no numeric-encoding ambiguity across languages: a second implementation reading 4200 as a float and re-serialising it would otherwise change the file without changing its meaning.
